feature_bullets: 3 WAYS TO PLAY - ①Hanging Tee: Baseballs with self-stick covers and can be hung anywhere from 15" to 30" off the ground. The novel hanging tee brings more fun for kids! ②Fixed Standing Tee: The traditional tee can better help kids practice how to hit the ball. ③Automatic Launcher: Very easy to use, child only needs to hit an automatically ejected baseball

ADJUSTABLE HEIGHT - ①The hanging baseball tee adjusts from 24.4" to 39.4" in height. ②The fixed standing tee adjusts from 22.6" to 37.2" in height. Easy to twist and lock the height, you can adjust different heights for your child. Let the baseball toys grow with your child

EASY TO ASSEMBLE - Our baseball set includes a retractable bat, an automatic launcher, 6 balls, a storage bag and all necessary assembly accessories. We include clear assembly instructions that take only 5 minutes to follow. It’s very easy to switch between a hanging tee and a standing tee

SAFE & STURDY - HYES baseball set is made up of high-quality durable materials, the base is an X-shape, making the teeball stand more sturdy and not easy to tip over. The smooth & round edge and non-slip handle design can protect your baby’s hands. Let your baby experience baseball safely

IDEAL SPORT GIFT FOR KIDS - Our baseball toys can be quickly disassembled and stored. It is a great sports game for both outdoors and indoors. This baseball gift can enhance your child's interest in sports and improve their hand-eye coordination. HYES baseball toy set is the perfect gift for birthdays, Christmas, Thanksgiving and New Year

top_reviews.title: Broke on the first day! - Refunded
top_reviews.body: Cheap. 2 year old broke it on the first day.- Update, seller refunded me the full amount.

date.raw: Reviewed in the United States on January 3, 2026

top_reviews.title: Good quality for toddlers
top_reviews.body: Bought this for my 4 year old and he loves it. His favorite part is the push down ball launcher. Practice made easy

date.raw: Reviewed in the United States on March 12, 2026

top_reviews.title: Good for Pre-Schoolers
top_reviews.body: This was a little less quality than I expected but it's OK for the price. I wouldn't suggest it for older kids but it works fine for my 3 year old grandson. It's definitely a starter kit - for when grandma gets tired of pitching!

date.raw: Reviewed in the United States on December 29, 2025

top_reviews.title: MLB here we come!
top_reviews.body: So in love with this product, super fun. My toddler loves hitting the ball it’s safe and functional anywhere. The value was great. It has adjustable size if your toddler is a little tall like mine. Storage space is barely needed.  It’s loud when the balls hit the ground but they’re the perfect size for the little ones

date.raw: Reviewed in the United States on January 22, 2026

top_reviews.title: Great gift!!
top_reviews.body: Great gift for toddlers to prepare them for T-ball. My 3 yr old granddaughter loves it and it’s easy for her to use on her own.

date.raw: Reviewed in the United States on February 17, 2026

top_reviews.title: Missing parts, but toddler still enjoys it
top_reviews.body: Good quality considering the low price we paid. Unfortunately I believe we are missing the white inner tube part that connects the hanging tee (see photo). Not super stable, I wish the bottom part was heavier because with almost every hit my 3 year old does the tee falls over so we normally put heavy ankle weights on each of the 4 posts coming out of the bottom. Despite all that my son does love it and uses it often

date.raw: Reviewed in the United States on December 28, 2025

top_reviews.title: Fun and Versatile Baseball Set for Little Kids
top_reviews.body: This baseball set has been such a hit with my toddler! I love that it’s a 3-in-1 design—the tee stand, hanging tee, and ball launcher all keep things exciting and help kids practice in different ways. The adjustable height is perfect as they grow, and the soft balls make it safe to use indoors or outdoors.It’s lightweight, easy to set up, and surprisingly sturdy for the price. My child has so much fun while improving coordination and confidence. Definitely a great gift idea for active kids who love sports!

date.raw: Reviewed in the United States on August 21, 2025

top_reviews.title: Fun baseball set
top_reviews.body: Really fun idea and its a good price. The nat keeps closing/ collapsing so I may super glue it. One of the pieces came a little warped but im trying to bend it back in place. My kids still enjoy it.

date.raw: Reviewed in the United States on December 29, 2025

top_reviews.title: What every young Australian lad needs
top_reviews.body: Good product should keep him happy for hours
Está padre para un niño de 2-4 años solo las pelotas se me hacen muy frágiles, pensé estaba más alto pero cumple con su función.

top_reviews.title: Pop up
top_reviews.body: Great product for young kids. Wish it was more sturdy, the stand that is. My kid broke it by hitting it a couple time, nothing some tape couldn’t fix. But the pop up is awesome. That’s what he’s using more than the tee and the hanging tee. This is really good for beginners

top_reviews.title: Didn't last long.
top_reviews.body: Overall the kit feels a little cheap, and unfortunately the automatic pop up has already jammed. My son still loves the balls and bat, however, the broken unit is a huge let down. Will be chasing a refund.
